claims.text: DMARDs, esp MTX and bio (eg, etanercept, anakinra, canakinumab, tocilizumab, abatacept), have chged JIA tx.
claims.quote: disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs), particularly methotrexate and the biologic agents (eg, etanercept, anakinra, canakinumab, tocilizumab, abatacept), have dramatically changed the therapeutic approach

claims.text: MTX: useful for oligoarticular, psoriatic and polyarticular JIA;
claims.quote: Methotrexate is useful for oligoarticular, psoriatic, and polyarticular forms of JIA.

claims.text: monitor for bone marrow depression and hepatotoxicity (CBC, AST, ALT, albumin).
claims.quote: Bone marrow depression and hepatic toxicity are monitored with complete blood count, aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), and albumin.

claims.text: TNF inhibitors (etanercept, adalimumab, infliximab) if MTX fails or ↑risk of poor outcome.
claims.quote: TNF inhibitors are used if methotrexate is not effective or if patients are at high risk of a poor outcome. Etanercept, adalimumab, and infliximab are TNF inhibitors that have been shown to be effective.

claims.text: IL-1 inhibitors anakinra and canakinumab: esp effective for systemic JIA;
claims.quote: The IL-1 inhibitors anakinra and canakinumab are particularly effective for systemic JIA.

claims.text: tocilizumab (IL-6 receptor antagonist): systemic and polyarticular JIA.
claims.quote: Tocilizumab, an IL-6 receptor antagonist, is also indicated for the treatment of systemic JIA and polyarticular JIA.
